generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Corrigendum / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the KPP portal only.

Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid. Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected. The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever. Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund. Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt., orders as may be modified from time to time.

a) Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2025-26. b) The Tenderer should maintain the Work during defective liability period i.e., ONE Year from the completion date. c) The Tenders are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document, All terms and conditions as per tender documents and Other details can be seen in the tender documents.
As per Government Order NO: FD 884 EXP 12 /2019 Banglore Dated 07-05-2020 action will be taken if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading /forged or fake.

Bidders have to quote and execute the work as per the detailed specification given in Sanctioned estimate and the instructions of the Engineer incharge. The copy of the estimate can be obtained from the Asst. Executive Engineers office, City Corporation Davanagere during Office hours.

Certificate of registration in the labor Department / Provident Fund / ESI should be enclosed and shall engage a construction worker who is registered with the Karnataka Building and construction Workers Welfare Board.
As per the Govt. Order No.DE 447 Exp-12/2022 Dated : 30-07-2022 GST will be added to the contract amount separately.
The tenderer should be a PWD registered Contractor - Class-3 and above
Bidder shall comply with all provisions of Manual scavengers act 2013 and rules made there under including administrative orders advisories any issued by the government from time to time

itemList.description:
Mechanical Means -
Earth work in surface excavation by mechanical means for lowering & leveling the ground for all  works other than foundation in all kinds of soils & upto depth not exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical   specifications, including setting out,   shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting &  stacking the selected  earth for reuse in a radius of   50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenances required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils upto 300 mm depth

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -3- EARTH WORK, EROSION CONTROL AND DRAINAGE
itemList.description: Compacting Original Ground - Compacting original ground supporting embankment - Loosening, leveling  and Compacting original ground supporting embankment to facilitate placement of first layer of embankment, scarified to a depth of 150 mm, mixed with water at OMC and then compacted  by  rolling  so  as  to  achieve  minimum  dry  density  as given in Table 300-2 for embankment construction. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 305.3.4

Manual Means -
Construction  of  Embankment  by  excavating  the  available  approved  Gravel/ Murrum deposited at a place or borrow pits during or prior excavation with all lifts and lead, transportation to site, spreading, grading to required slope and compacting to meet the requirement complete as per specifications, including cost of labour,rolling,water,all materials,usage& all other appurtenaces required to complete the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method) - Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 406

Precast Cement Concrete Interlocking Blocks - Providing  and  laying  60mm  thick  factory  made  precast  M  -30 grade  Cement  Concrete  Paver  Block  as  per  IRC  SP  63:2018  & IS  15658  for  Cycle  Tracks  &  Pedestrian  Footpaths  of  approved shape  and  colour,  laid  in  required  pattern  and  including  over 30mm thick compacted bed of coarse sand, filling the joints with fine  sand  etc.  all  complete  as  per  the  direction  of  Engineer-in- charge. (WMM/WBM Base to be paid separately if necessary as per relevant technical specification). Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - IRC SP 63:2018

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Kerb Stones - Supplying and fixing M15 grade precast cement concrete Kerb stones  for  Roadway,  Sidewalls  and  gutters  fixed  with  CM  1:3 fixed and finsihed in line as per direction of Engineer in charge. (The cost of PCC shall be paid extra) - 600 x 300 x 150 mm size

Manual Means -
Earth work   excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of Buildings & bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including  setting  out,   shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,  removal of stumps and other deleterious matter,   excavated surface leveled and sides neatly  dressed  disposing  off  the  excavated  stuff  or  sorting  &    stacking  the selected  stuff for reuse in a radius of  50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 1.5 m

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete  for  levelling  course  for all  works  in  foundation.  The    granite/trap/basalt    crushed  graded  coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  and all the other  appurtenances  required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - Mix 1:4:8 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete   for  all  Sub  structures  of building,  Irrigation  works,  Sub  structure  works  of  bridges,  Drain  works    & other  parallel  works  from  0.50m  to  3.50  m  height.  The  granite/trap/basalt crushed  graded  coarse  aggregates    and  fine  aggregates    as  per  relevant  IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers,   laid in layers, well compacted using needle   vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of   relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - M 20   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -3- EARTH WORK, EROSION CONTROL AND DRAINAGE
itemList.description: Removal  of  Unserviceable  Soil  with  Disposal  upto  a  suitable distance as directed by the Engineer incharge of work.  Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 301

Dismantling  old  plaster  or  skirting  raking  out  joints  and  cleaning  the surface for plaster including disposal of rubbish to the dumping ground to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.

Wall  painting  with  acrylic  emulsion  paint  of  approved  brand  and manufacture  to  give  an  even  shade  :Two  coats  on  new  work   after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Supply, Transportation, Installation of Mild Steel (MS) Park Benches with Nano-Coated Wooden Finish (Teak/Rosewood Grains).The MS benches are manufactured from mild steel. The benches are treated with metal epoxy primer, jet black coating, and nano-coated with clear wooden finish Teak/Rosewood grains.The final finish is between 70 to 90 microns, made to endure corrosion, rust, oxidation, and is also protective against UV damage. The bench is made to withhold a seating capacity of 225 kgs. The benches are composed of 2mm thick 20x40mm pipes for the seat and 20x40mm for the backrest, with 7 pipes for the seat and 6 pipes for the backrest. The hand rest is made of a 20x40mm pipe, positioned 24" from ground level. The base plate is 80x80x6mm, with 4 plates per bench. The armrest will be curved on both ends, measuring 2ft in length each, joining the legs of the bench. Each leg of the bench will have a 4” diameter plate at the base. The grouting will be 6” into the surface. The dimensions of the bench are 6ft in length, 2ft in depth, and 3.6ft in total height, including the backrest. The seat height from the ground is 18”, and the backrest height is 18”. The manufacturer must possess a valid ZED (Zero Defect Zero Effect) Bronze Certificate.
